ios.desc:
Lock In: Visualize Your Time, Master Your Life.

Stop letting time slip away. Lock In Daily transforms how you see and manage your days, year, goals, and life itself through a clean, minimalist interface designed for focus.

Master Your Day:

Effortless Task Management: Organize daily to-dos with intuitive lists.

Subtasks: Break down complex items for clarity.

Routines Made Simple: Set recurring tasks (daily, weekly) and let Lock In handle the schedule.

Day Progress: Visually track your day's flow from your custom start to end time – see hours remaining at a glance.

Conquer Your Year:

Visual Year Tracker: See the entire year as 52 weeks. Watch completed weeks get marked visually and know exactly how much time remains.

Real-time Progress: An animated bar shows your year's percentage completion.

Stay Oriented: Instantly see the current month and days/weeks/hours left in the year.

Achieve Your Goals:

Set & Visualize: Define your personal goals with start and end dates.

Progress Grid: Each goal gets a unique grid where every square represents a day. Watch your progress fill in visually, day by day.

Deadline Focus: Clearly see days left and the target date to stay motivated and accountable.

Reflect on Your Life:

Life in Years: Visualize your lifespan based on your birth date and life expectancy.

Memento Mori: See lived years visually fill the grid, with the current year pulsing, reminding you to make the most of the present. See the years to come represented, leading towards the symbolic end.

Perspective: Gain a powerful, visual perspective on your life's journey so far and the time ahead.

Designed for Clarity:

Minimalist Aesthetic: Clean lines, clear typography, and a focus on what matters.

Dark & Light Modes: Choose the theme that suits your style and environment.

Intuitive Navigation: Seamlessly switch between tasks, year, goals, and age views.

Lock In Daily isn't just another productivity app; it's a visual companion for intentional living. It helps you focus on the now, plan for the future, and appreciate the journey.

Download Lock In Daily and start making everyday count.
